about:
LQ Mechatronics operates from Branford, Connecticut, as the U.S. arm of the LQ Group, a German system supplier specializing in electromechanical complete solutions for machine and plant engineering. The founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures modular control cabinets, energy guide systems, and custom cable assemblies, all built around its EnergyLink system kit—a standardized set of connectors, power cables, distributors, and functional modules that eliminate interface issues. It also assembles drag chains (energy chains) and provides end-to-end services from engineering through logistics. The group reports 365 specialists across three locations, producing 305,000 systems and 2,990 kilometers of cable annually.

LQ Mechatronics serves machine builders, plant constructors, and the packaging industry, evidenced by its membership in the Packaging Valley network since 2016. Its solutions are used in automation environments requiring robust, pre-assembled energy chains and compact functional modules such as the A-TEC series.

The company emphasizes complexity reduction through standardized interfaces, claiming accelerated processes and 100% tested quality on every custom assembly. Its differentiation rests on delivering pre-assembled, ready-to-install energy chains and a holistic approach covering engineering to after-sales service.
